M1.reason: All six views and the four close angles match the original's outline. Measured silhouette overlap is 0.969 to 0.973 in every view, and no part sticks out or is missing in the top or below views.

M2.reason: Measured size is 22.9 x 30.1 x 75.1 against the original's 22.8 x 30.2 x 75.3, off by 0.2% per axis, well inside 10%.

M3.reason: Helmet with visor, vest with straps and the yellow emblem, the SECURITY lettering on the back, the hip pouch or holster, sleeves, trousers, boots with laces and both hands are all present, in the right places and shapes.

M4.reason: Measured mean colour difference is 6.2 (CIE76 delta E, smoothed), with the worst view at 8.9, well under 15. Visually the skin, helmet, vest and trousers are all in the same colour family. The trousers look a little more mottled, which is texture and belongs to M5.

M5.reason: The vest emblem, straps and SECURITY lettering are there, but the face's features (eyes, mouth, lines) are blurred and smeared compared with the original's crisp face, and the trousers have dirty patches that the original does not. Clearly off in sharpness, though not a must-have.

M6.reason: At game size the figure reads as the same guard, but the face is a different, dirtier face with blurred features, the helmet reads greyer, and the trousers look mottled. A player who knows this guard would see the difference, so a player would not take it for the original.

M7.reason: The front faces the front in every view, the figure stands upright, and its feet sit at the same level as the original's (the front views line up at the same baseline).

M8.reason: SMAK checkErrors is empty. 700 triangles against the original's 785 is under twice. The static views show nothing open, inside out or floating.

C1.reason: In the run frames (reproduction frames 3/22 to 22/22) the boots come apart from the legs: each boot is a large flat black wedge that trails and slides under the trousers, and the trouser legs do not reach it. The original's legs and boots move together through the stride. Parts come apart and sink, which the rubric does not allow.
